correctness.rationale: The term-function model is valid for the variety generated by the finite Lie algebra. Every commutator has coefficient vector in the module generated by a_i e_j-a_j e_i; repeated adjoints multiply by coordinate functions. Finite-field interpolation makes this module the direct sum of the hyperplanes a^perp over all nonzero a. This gives derived dimension (n-1)(q^n-1), and the n-dimensional generator span is a direct complement. Exhaustive term-function closure over F_2 and F_3 matches the formula in five small cases. No finite experiment is used to infer the general theorem.
